classification.difficultyReason: 1F Q72: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. PDF29's square bases become x and 1/x. Their product is 1, so the balancing constant is 2; the original denominator excludes zero.

content.prompt:
Complete the square of the following by adding the $2ab$ term.
$$x^2+\frac1{x^2}$$

answer.worked:
For $x\ne0$, the middle term is $2x\left(\frac1x\right)=2$.
$$\begin{align*}x^2+\frac1{x^2}&=x^2+2+\frac1{x^2}-2\\x^2+\frac1{x^2}&=\left(x+\frac1x\right)^2-2.\end{align*}$$
Alternatively:
$$\begin{align*}x^2+\frac1{x^2}&=x^2-2+\frac1{x^2}+2\\x^2+\frac1{x^2}&=\left(x-\frac1x\right)^2+2.\end{align*}$$
